title: Mixed Regime � APPR + ASL Eligible (Most Generous Selected)
description:
Mixed Regime � APPR + ASL (ASL Not Eligible at 4hr Delay � APPR Only Eligible). Flight from Toronto (YYZ) to Tel Aviv (TLV) � Canada departure, Israel arrival. APPR applies (Canada departure) AND ASL applies (Israel arrival). At 4hr delay: APPR = $400 CAD (Tier 1, 3�<6h). However, per the Confluence compensation table, ASL compensation only starts at 8+ hours (3670 ILS). At 4hr delay, ASL has NO applicable compensation amount and is NOT ELIGIBLE. Only APPR produces an eligible result ? APPR selected as the only eligible regime. Validates that ASL's 8-hour threshold is correctly applied and that the system does not award ASL compensation below 8 hours.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (Noam Golan), 1 leg AC operated YYZ?TLV. Itinerary: Scheduled arrival 06:00 (TLV local), Actual arrival 10:00 (4hr delay). Disruption code: 42 (Controllable). Flight status: Arrived (operated). Booking changes: None. Carrier: AC only. Route context: Canada departure (YYZ) ? APPR applies; Israel arrival (TLV) ? ASL applies; Not EU origin ? EU N/A. ASL note: Per compensation table, ASL starts at 8+ hours � at 4hr delay, ASL has no applicable compensation.
